title: Bible Listening Plan
description: A 7-day journey through key Bible passages with guided audio listening.

days.title: The Beginning
days.description: Listen to the creation account and reflect on God's power and creativity.

days.title: The Shepherd's Psalm
days.description: Experience the comfort of God's presence as your shepherd.

days.title: The Beatitudes
days.description: Hear Jesus' teaching on blessedness and kingdom values.

days.title: The Lord's Prayer
days.description: Learn the pattern of prayer Jesus taught his disciples.

days.title: The Good Shepherd
days.description: Jesus reveals himself as the good shepherd who lays down his life.

days.title: Love Chapter
days.description: Paul's beautiful description of God's love and how we should love.

days.title: The Great Commission
days.description: Jesus sends his disciples to make disciples of all nations.
